**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document sits at the **preferred** position for MINCOMMIT:

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," with fees payable only for Services ordered under an executed Order Form, and an express statement that declining a further Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — Vendor may not impose any minimum-use or similar charge not identified in the Order Form, closing the back-door route to a volume floor.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** — Confirms we have made no minimum-volume (or exclusivity/MFC/no-hire) commitment.

The only "shortfall" language in the document (§§ 22.2–22.3) relates to audit underpayments for usage actually consumed, not a take-or-pay obligation. Exclusivity is handled separately under the EXCLUSIVITY rule and is not double-flagged here.
